title: TrackerSpokeSyncService
responsibility: Synchronize one Tracker link with the local spoke journal using signed batches and durable link-specific cursors.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Injected local journal, transport and signing key. Defaults to the hub link, relaying on a peer only, and a 25-second pull wait.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity.dbId
inputs.description: Database identifier from the validated response.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor.key
inputs.description: Legacy metadata key for the local push or remote pull sequence.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request.request
inputs.description: HTTP method, exact path and query, and optional serialized body.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.push
outputs.description: Count of operations acknowledged during this drain, including duplicates accepted by the receiver.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.pull
outputs.description: Applied page and cursor, a durable identity reset requiring replay and another poll, or a stale reply to discard.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity
outputs.description: Whether a known database was replaced and its cursors reset.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor
outputs.description: A nonnegative safe integer cursor, with zero for an absent value.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request
outputs.description: Decoded JSON from the configured transport.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A persisted cursor, push receipt or pull page is invalid. Failures from the journal and transport propagate as supplied.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.push
outputs.description: Count of operations acknowledged during this drain, including duplicates accepted by the receiver.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects a malformed push receipt or stored cursor. Transport and journal failures also reject, leaving the unacknowledged batch eligible for retry.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.pull
outputs.description: Applied page and cursor, a durable identity reset requiring replay and another poll, or a stale reply to discard.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects a malformed pull page or stored cursor. Transport and journal failures also reject, leaving an unapplied page eligible for retry.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity.dbId
inputs.description: Database identifier from the validated response.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity
outputs.description: Whether a known database was replaced and its cursors reset.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor.key
inputs.description: Legacy metadata key for the local push or remote pull sequence.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor
outputs.description: A nonnegative safe integer cursor, with zero for an absent value.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects corrupt cursor metadata that is not a nonnegative safe integer.

inputs.description: HTTP method, exact path and query, and optional serialized body.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request
outputs.description: Decoded JSON from the configured transport.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Injected local journal, transport and signing key. Defaults to the hub link, relaying on a peer only, and a 25-second pull wait.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor
outputs.description: A client for one configured link. The caller schedules polls and retries.
